cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The chair beside you. Just introduce them as you normally would.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair; we can't ask someone to stand just because Mum can't see them.

mechanism: A directs household manners so B must treat an invisible guest as a person with an ordinary claim to a seat.
confusable: Unlike proving invisibility, A seeks B's participation in introductions and seating without debating the premise.
comparison: Mum needs a chair and B misaddresses the furniture, unlike the cupboard's service adaptations.
seedUse: The seed already assigns introduction, corrects its recipient and directs a second chair; S01 drives the social normalization.
